stage.block_reason: Retained v7 transition evidence. Superseded by step5d_strict_rnn_liveprep_v8 because v7 still relied on slow-only 24.3 re-contact plus a passive contact window, while v8 makes 25.3 an active force PID settle stage before strict RNN qdot.

filter_policy.semantic_contract: reaction normal for load, approach normal for posture/press direction

liveprep_gates: UR force/frame semantic gate passes v2/v4 Stage 25.0 replay
v6 failure-contrast gate proves 24.3 re-contact overpressure before the 25.0 controller
non-quarantine Step5d v7 TP package validates locally and contains speedj qdot executor for Stage 25.0
24.3/24.4 second contact search is slow-only with near_start_depth=0m and 2.5mm/s command speed
25.3 contact window entry gate requires normal_load between 2N and 15N plus force_norm <=25N for 0.050s before Stage 25.0
bridge limits live Step5d xdot_c before strict RNN while preserving raw xdot diagnostics
bridge hard-fails the Step5d semantic gate before RNN/qdot if orientation semantics disagree
controller upload and read-back SHA/cachedContents verification pass
separate live dry-run/contact SOP is accepted before bridge or TP Play

semantic_control_gate.failure_contrast: v6 replay shows Stage 24.3 stayed in far phase for about 20mm, never reached 24.4, entered 25.0 at about 22N, then lost contact
semantic_control_gate.forbidden: Do not normalize raw live force to construct R_d.z or orientation_target_axis
semantic_control_gate.gate_scope: offline replay and runtime regression guard; not an independent closed-loop stability proof
semantic_control_gate.runtime_assertion: contact-search orientation error and Step5d outer-loop orientation angle must agree within 5 deg before cmd_valid can remain true

stage.success_condition: Retained v7 transition evidence only. Superseded by v8 because 25.3 now actively settles force instead of only waiting for a contact window.
